currentParagraphText: “Dina has already experienced this,” the second-in-command of the Pantheon of Life said with a small smile. “Those fifty years in Nevermore were far more beneficial than I can even imagine. Not just for her immediate growth, but the Records from the connections she formed will help her Path greatly.”
